newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Sunwear May same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Sunwear May same-store sales rise.

text.p: Pacific Sunwear of California Inc Thursday reported sales of $13.4 million for the four week period ended June 1, an increase of 36 percent over sales of $9.8 million for the comparable four week period ended June 2, 1996. Same store sales increased 13 percent for the period.

Sales for the first seventeen weeks ended June 1, 1997 were $52.3 million, an increase of 40 percent over sales of $37.5 million for the same period last year. Same store sales increased 16 percent for the first seventeen weeks.

Pacific Sunwear said it plans to open 50 new stores in 1997 and complete 12 to 15 expansions or relocations, to the larger store format, which will increase total store square footage about 33 percent. To date in 1997, the company has opened 13 new stores and completed two expansions or relocations.
